bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge code, sfifo_esrng_push was asserted whenever es_enable_fo[5], es_delayed_enable, and es_rng_src_valid were high, without checking rng_enable_q. Because rng_enable is now a registered output, there is a cycle after re-enable where es_delayed_enable is already true but rng_enable_q has not yet been asserted. In that cycle the module can still push AST-valid data into the raw-entropy input FIFO even though the RNG enable/ready output is low. This violates the specification that a raw entropy sample is accepted only when both RNG enable and RNG valid are asserted, and causes the RTL, AST push-pull agent, and scoreboard to become out of sync.
bug_info.fix_hint: Gate the input FIFO push with the registered ready output: sfifo_esrng_push should also require rng_enable_q so that data from the RNG interface is only pushed into sfifo_esrng while the module is actually indicating ready to the AST RNG source.
